newsitem.title: USA: Ponder terminates debt conversion talks.
newsitem.headline: Ponder terminates debt conversion talks.

text.p: Ponder Industries Inc said Tuesday that it has terminated negotiations with the holders of its eight percent Convertible Debentures.
Ponder said that it intends to pursue damages and a declaratory judgment that it is no longer obligated to convert its convertible debentures into shares of common stock.
The company said it it expects to take a "significant" charge against fiscal 1996 earnings in light of anticipated litigation expenses.
Ponder said its suit against the debentureholders includes an action against its former placement agent for breach of fiduciary duties and negligence.
Ponder said the suit alleges that an unknown number of debentureholders violated the anti-fraud and anti-market manipulation provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
